program_name: Wirex Affiliates Program (Impact) — plus legacy 'Earn Bitcoin' referral page
application_conditions: Help centre affiliate FAQ (2026-11-10): 'Wirex welcomes both individual and business affiliates to join the program' (individuals fill the Company Information section with personal details); applications 'typically approved within five business days'; runs on Impact; partner types 'Offline' and 'Other' not accepted. No existing-customer or active-card requirement stated for this programme. The 2026-10-26 read of wirexapp.com/affiliate (Earn Bitcoin page) required an active card — that page could not be re-fetched this run (provenance).
paid_action: Affiliate FAQ: 'Successful referrals or actions' — not defined on the page. Launch blog post (undated, ~April 2023): rewarded 'for every user that signs up and uses Wirex Multiply, X-Accounts or DUO products, or makes a transaction with their debit card', 'up to $50 per customer'. Earn Bitcoin page (2026-10-26): referred users' card load transactions.
validation_conditions: Referral must click the unique link and sign up on the same device and browser; Brave, Tor and cookie/GA-blocking browsers or extensions are incompatible; no manual attribution for referrals made before the referrer registered; revenue appears within up to 72 hours.

commission.model_note: Affiliate FAQ: 'Wirex offers the same terms for all affiliates, regardless of size'; no percentage, amount or duration published on the FAQ. Launch blog post: 'up to $50 per customer'. Earn Bitcoin page (2026-10-26 read): 10% of gross fees from referrals in year 1, then 5% for two more years (elsewhere 'forever' — inconsistent), paid in BTC — this is the personal referral scheme, not necessarily the Impact programme.

payout.method: Not stated on the affiliate FAQ (Impact dashboard). Earn Bitcoin page: BTC to the Wirex account.
payout.frequency: Affiliate FAQ: fee revenue updated monthly, visible by the 15th; 'Payments are processed 14 days later on the 29th'. Earn Bitcoin page: 'immediate'.

rules_note: Two distinct schemes now documented: (a) a publisher Affiliates Program on Impact (help-centre FAQ, no T&C link, no last-updated date, ©2026) and (b) the personal Earn Bitcoin referral requiring an active card (recorded 2026-10-26). Commission figures for (a) are not public. Separate refer-a-friend promotions have their own T&C pages (help centre articles 1454, 1534, 1323).

evidence.title: Wirex referral page
evidence.excerpt: 10% of gross fees year 1 then 5% for two years; requires an active card; BTC payouts.

evidence.title: Wirex affiliate FAQ (help centre; wirexapp.com/help/article/wirex-affiliate-faq-1325 redirects here)
evidence.excerpt: Individual and business affiliates welcome; same terms for all; Impact platform ('Create a Link' panel, banners); approval typically within five business days; 'Offline' and 'Other' partner types not accepted; revenue visible by the 15th, payments processed on the 29th; same-device/browser tracking, Brave/Tor incompatible. No rates, no T&C link, no date.

evidence.title: Introducing the Wirex Affiliates Program (official blog, undated — press release dated April 2023)
evidence.excerpt: 'up to $50 per customer' for every user that signs up and uses Multiply, X-Accounts or DUO or makes a debit-card transaction; unified dashboard; sign-up at wirexapp.com/affiliate. Context only — figures possibly outdated.

notes: Personal referral, not a publisher programme: requires David to be a Wirex customer. Decision needed before any use. 2026-11-10: the help centre documents a publisher Affiliates Program on Impact open to individuals and businesses — a publisher route exists after all (status stays identified; no application made). Commission terms are not public: they must be read inside Impact after acceptance. The Earn Bitcoin page (wirexapp.com/affiliate) could not be re-fetched this run.
